content.text: Clear picture. Quick check of config changes, dependency logs, other alerts, and runbooks.

input.action: Roll back search-api deploy 33e07ac (in-process ProfileCache) to the previous build
input.reason: Since dep-001 (20:03), the logs show ProfileCache entries and heap after GC climbing steadily from 69% to 97%. Then from 21:28:55 the pods hit repeated OutOfMemoryError in ProfileCache.put and restart, which lines up with the 5xx and latency alerts. rb-004 says to rule out a leak before scaling, and the leak is confirmed here.

input.text_body: INC-2615 RCA draft (proposal). Root cause: search-api deploy 33e07ac (dep-001, 2026-10-14T20:03:00Z, "Cache customer profiles in-process") added an in-process ProfileCache with no bound. Heap used after GC rose from 69% (entries=1242000, 20:22) to 97% (entries=1746000, 21:10). From 21:28:55 pods crashed in a loop with "OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space in ProfileCache.put; container restarting". First impacting alert alt-001 at 21:30:00: 5xx rate 43.3%. Latency alerts alt-002/alt-003 and web-frontend alt-004 followed. Ruled out: dep-002 (21:16, README.md only, cannot cause runtime errors); reporting-service deploys dep-003/dep-004 (not in the search-api dependency chain); dependencies catalog-service and search-index (INFO logs only, healthy); fraud-scoring CPU alert alt-005 (unrelated service, a separate issue). No config changes in the window. Mitigation proposed: roll back 33e07ac. Follow-up: put a size limit or eviction on ProfileCache, and add a heap usage alert.

hypotheses.claim: search-api deploy 33e07ac added an in-process ProfileCache with no bound. Heap grew until the pods hit OOM and started a crash loop, which caused the 5xx errors and the latency spikes.
hypotheses.disproving_check: query_logs search-api pattern 'ProfileCache' before 20:03: if entries/heap growth predates dep-001, the deploy is not the cause

hypotheses.claim: README typo deploy 36cb56c caused the errors.
hypotheses.disproving_check: get_deploys search-api: changed files limited to README.md; heap growth started before 21:16

hypotheses.claim: A failure in the catalog-service or search-index dependency caused the search-api errors.
hypotheses.disproving_check: query_logs catalog-service/search-index level ERROR in the window

hypotheses.claim: Changes to reporting-service or load on fraud-scoring spilled over into search-api.
hypotheses.disproving_check: get_dependencies search-api: neither service is in its chain

input.rca_draft: At 2026-10-14T20:03:00Z, search-api deploy 33e07ac (dep-001) began caching customer profiles in-process with no size limit. Heap used after GC rose from 69% to 97% as ProfileCache entries grew. From 21:28:55, OutOfMemoryError in ProfileCache.put put the containers into a crash-restart loop. This caused the 5xx rate of 43.3% (alt-001, 21:30), the p99 latency alerts and the upstream errors in web-frontend. Ruled out: the README-only deploy dep-002, the reporting-service deploys, the healthy dependencies catalog-service and search-index, and the unrelated fraud-scoring CPU alert. Proposed mitigation: roll back 33e07ac.
